evidence_items.text:
- Friend/acquaintance of Calvin; was congratulating Calvin on his new home, following up on his plans to go to Japan, and asking how long Calvin will stay (see /memories/calvin.md) as of 2023-03-23 [S1T4][S1T8][S1T14][S1T16].
- On 2023-03-26, congratulated Calvin on his new luxury car [S2T2][S2T6]; later that day asked Calvin what's new in his life after their talk about the festival and his favorite band [S2T16].
- On 2023-03-26, looking forward to hearing Calvin's new tunes and asked him to keep him updated on his collaborations [S2T18][S2T20].
- On 2023-04-20, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see"), who reported back from a Tokyo music festival; Dave reacted enthusiastically and asked what Calvin learned and where he sees his music taking him [S3T1][S3T2][S3T4][S3T6][S3T8].
- On 2023-05-31, caught up with Calvin ("been ages since we chatted"); congratulated Calvin on the Frank Ocean tour (Tokyo stop; details in /memories/calvin.md) [S7T1][S7T2]. Shared a photo of himself fixing a neighbor's car engine in a garage (details in ## Car maintenance shop) and told Calvin that working on cars is "definitely therapeutic"; Calvin said fixing cars calms him down "like meditating" and asked whether Dave has hobbies with the same satisfaction — Dave described his passion for fixing up things as more than a hobby, giving purpose and a sense of achievement (details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S7T2][S7T4][S7T5][S7T6]. The exchange ended with the two agreeing that transforming something and giving it a new life makes them feel like they "really achieved something" [S7T7][S7T8]. The 2023-05-31 conversation continued: Calvin echoed the "feeling of power and happiness" ("It's great to see what we created with all our hard work and ideas") [S7T9]; Dave asked whether Calvin always enjoys performing live (Calvin: it "always fuels my soul" — an "absolute high") [S7T10][S7T11], and Dave marveled at the artist-audience connection and the concert crowd photos Calvin shared (a large crowd taking pictures; a crowd watching a concert with bright lights; a band on stage), calling the atmosphere "off the charts" and saying music "brings people together ... like therapy for us all" [S7T12][S7T13][S7T14]; when Dave asked what's next for Calvin's music, Calvin named the Boston stop on the Frank Ocean tour, and Dave said he'll be there to cheer him on (details in ## Boston) [S7T14][S7T15][S7T16]. The conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave for his support and saying he can't wait to experience the Boston music scene; Dave wished Calvin a great time in Boston and said he can't wait to hear all about it when he gets back, and Calvin promised to fill him in on all the details, signing off "See you soon!" [S7T17][S7T18][S7T19].
- On 2023-04-20, continued the catch-up: offered to show Calvin around Boston (Paradise Rock, House of Blues, Fenway Park), said he'll be in the front row when Calvin performs, and agreed to grab food at his favorite spots when Calvin visits (details in ## Boston) [S3T10][S3T15][S3T16]. Calvin shared a photo of his red sports car on display at a show, and Dave praised the work put into it [S3T13][S3T14].
- On 2023-05-01, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see") and announced that he had finally opened his own car maintenance shop — a dream come true and a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars; shared a photo of the shop (including a group of people in front of a car) and of the engine of the classic car he restored in 2022, and invited Calvin to come by; Calvin congratulated him, the conversation closed with mutual encouragement, and Calvin shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant (details in ## Car maintenance shop, ## Classic cars, and /memories/calvin.md) [S4T1][S4T5][S4T7][S4T15][S4T16][S4T17][S4T22][S4T23][S4T24].
- On 2023-05-01, complimented Calvin's necklace and asked where he got it (Calvin: a gift from another artist, a reminder of why he keeps hustling as a musician); encouraged Calvin to keep pushing and making music, and the two agreed to keep each other motivated — "the road can be hard, but when we remember why we're doing it, it keeps us going" (in Calvin's words) [S4T25][S4T26][S4T27][S4T28].

- The 2023-06-09 conversation continued: Calvin asked what was new and exciting for Dave, and Dave announced he booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month (July 2023) — "finally gonna be able to see those majestic peaks" (details in ## Mountain trip (July 2023)) [S8T10]. Calvin said he wants to go on a hike in the mountains to escape it all and de-stress — see /memories/calvin.md > ## Mountains and hiking [S8T9]. The two exchanged trip wishes and signed off "see you soon" [S8T11][S8T12][S8T13][S8T14].
- On 2023-06-21, Calvin told Dave about a car accident he had on 2023-06-16 (no one hurt); Dave expressed sympathy, asked whether the insurance process had any issues and how long it took to sort out, and asked about the mechanic in Calvin's garage photo. Details of the accident and repair are in /memories/calvin.md > ## Car accident (2023-06-16) [S9T2][S9T4][S9T6][S9T8].
- On 2023-06-21 (continuing the car-repair conversation), Dave said it's awesome that Calvin trusts the people fixing the car — "Sounds like they're doing a great job. It'll be back to normal soon!" [S9T10].
- On 2023-06-21, Calvin then shared a photo of a small-town view in Japan with a mountain in the background; Dave marveled at it — "I haven't seen anything like that before!" — asked where it was and whether Calvin has been there; Calvin said not yet, but it's on his to-do list for after the Frank Ocean tour — see /memories/calvin.md > ## Japan plan [S9T11][S9T12][S9T13][S9T14][S9T15].
- On 2023-06-21, Calvin shared a photo of a person on skis on a snowy mountain ("Look at that snowy peak"); Dave asked whether Calvin has ever tried skiing before, and Calvin answered that he hasn't tried it, but it looks like "a lot of fun" and he might give it a try once — see /memories/calvin.md > ## Mountains and hiking [S9T15][S9T16][S9T17].
